one_line: OpenAI countersues Apple, Meta updates UK Muse terms following regulatory warnings, and Embo launches with $110M.

themes.title: OpenAI and Meta face regulatory and legal scrutiny
themes.text: OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple in a California court, accusing the iPhone maker of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers. Meanwhile, Meta updated the terms of service for its Muse personal AI agent in the UK to reflect local consumer law following warnings from the Competition and Markets Authority regarding user control and autonomy.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier threats
UK regulator warns AI agents must provide user control as Meta Muse launches
Meta changes UK Muse terms of service to reflect consumer law

themes.title: Robotics startups and investments expand
themes.text: Embo emerged from stealth with a $110 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz to build robot world models trained on internet video. Additionally, a Morgan Stanley report projects that investment in Chinese humanoid robots will accelerate ahead of selective commercial use in 2027.

stories.headline: Embo emerges from stealth with $110M seed led by a16z for robot world models
China humanoid robot investment to rise, selective use by 2027

themes.title: Legal disputes involve AI authorship and automated leasing
themes.text: The Delhi High Court will examine whether an AI system can be recognized as an author under Indian copyright law following an appeal involving Stephen Thaler's DABUS. In North Carolina, a woman was evicted after an AI leasing agent mistakenly approved a rent delay in writing that management refused to honor.

stories.headline: Delhi High Court to examine if AI can be author under copyright law
Raleigh woman evicted after AI assistant mistakenly approved rent delay
